title: UN Commission finding on damage to Gaza health care
summary: The Commission examined the effect of Israeli military operations on Gaza’s health-care facilities and services through 31 December 2023.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli attacks severely damaged Gaza’s health-care infrastructure, reducing the availability and accessibility of health services.
legal_characterization: Factual finding by a UN commission of inquiry; this record does not characterize attacks on hospitals as a specific war crime and is not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the health-care discussion in paragraphs 70-75 of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission’s reasonable-grounds standard in paragraph 6. The claim is limited to the reported damage and effect on health services; it does not combine those passages with the report’s general legal finding about attacks on civilian objects or assert a hospital-specific war-crime finding.
